blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.
blocks.zh: 从以自我为中心的视频中重建人类活动需要的不仅仅是恢复单个的3D组件:观察者的运动,周围几何,手-物体的相互作用必须在一个连贯的世界中相接. 实现这种一致性需要联合重建和协调一致的监督,但现有的方法和数据集对两者的支持都很有限。 我们提出“EgoXperience”,一种通过数据收集、自动注释、统一建模和基准制定满足这些需要的全方位范例。 EgoXperience的中心是自动注释引擎EgoX-Engine,夫妇用基于SLAM的世界对齐进行几何验证的物体跟踪,对相机,场景,手和物体产生一致的监督. 这产生了EgoX-Data-6M,这是一套50小时的由任务驱动的在室内外环境内外操纵和运动的数据集,带有二级任务说明. 我们仔细挑选一个小时来评估联合重建活动。 为了将这种监督转化为重建,我们引进了EgoX,经过了EgoX-Data-6M的培训,并增加了公共数据集的补充说明. 我们的模型实现了相机、场景、手和物体在共享世界坐标框中的联合计量重建, 广泛的实验表明,现场估算和世界空间手取物体的性能都达到了最新水平。 根据最强的评价基线,EgoX将相机,手和深度误差减少68.9%,65.6%和42.9%,并将对象的分数提高28.0%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Egocentric video offers a natural perspective on how humans and embodied agents perceive and interact with the world, requiring only a wearable camera without external camera setups.
By capturing the wearer’s movement and close-range interactions, it provides visual cues for recovering camera pose, scene depth, hands, and objects.
However, existing methods [ 56 , 57 , 25 , 40 , 70 ] typically recover only a subset of these tightly coupled components.
Combining outputs from different methods often requires reconciling inconsistent scales and coordinate frames, complicating their use in downstream embodied AI applications.
This motivates a unified feed-forward framework that jointly recovers the camera, scene, hands, and objects within a single model.
blocks.zh:
以爱果心为中心视频自然展现出人类和所体现物剂如何感知和与世界互动的视角,只需要一台没有外相相机设置的可穿戴相机.
通过捕捉穿行者的动作和近距离相互作用,它为恢复相机姿势、场景深度、手和物体提供了视觉提示。
然而,现有方法[56、57、25、40、70]一般只回收这些紧密相接的组成部分中的一个子集。
结合不同方法的输出往往需要调和不一致的尺度和相协调的框架,使其在下游包含的AI应用中的使用复杂化.
这激励了一个统一的向导框架,在一个单一模型内共同回收相机,场景,手和物体.

blocks.en:
Training such a unified model, however, requires large-scale egocentric data with joint annotations of the camera, scene, hands, and objects.
Although egocentric video is easy to record, obtaining reliable joint annotations is considerably more difficult due to frequent hand-object occlusions, rapid head motion, and motion blur.
Existing datasets [ 7 , 3 , 39 , 12 , 58 ] have made progress toward this goal, often using calibrated multi-camera or motion-capture systems to support reliable annotations.
However, these systems require substantial setup and calibration, making collection difficult to scale across diverse real-world environments.
Scaling jointly annotated egocentric data therefore calls for a collection and annotation pipeline that reduces reliance on such specialized infrastructure.
blocks.zh:
然而,培训这样一个统一的模型需要大规模自我中心数据,并附上相机、场景、手和物体的联合说明。
虽然以自我为中心的视频很容易被录制,但由于经常被手取物封口,头部动作快,动作模糊等原因,获得可靠的联合说明要困难得多.
现有的数据集[7、3、39、12、58]在实现这一目标方面取得了进展,经常使用校准多相机或动作摄取系统来支持可靠的说明。
然而,这些系统需要大量的设置和校准,使得收集工作难以跨越不同的现实世界环境。
因此,要扩大共同附加说明的自我中心数据,就需要收集和注释,以减少对这类专门基础设施的依赖。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we present EgoXperience , a full-stack paradigm for egocentric 3D reconstruction, encompassing data collection, annotation, modeling, and benchmarking.
Central to its annotation pipeline is EgoX -Engine , which tracks target objects across video frames and uses pre-scanned object models and observed depth to estimate and verify their 3D poses.
SLAM-estimated camera poses place these object trajectories in a shared world coordinate system alongside scene geometry and hand annotations, providing geometrically aligned supervision.
Applying this engine to 50 hours of task-driven recordings spanning workspace manipulation, cross-room interactions, and outdoor loco-manipulation yields EgoX -Data-6M , further enriched with task captions at second-level temporal resolution.
To complement this dataset, we harmonize additional public interaction datasets [ 3 , 39 , 30 , 58 , 23 , 12 ] under a common training formulation, aligning their geometric conventions while retaining their partial annotations.
We also establish EgoX -Bench from one hour of held-out recordings, enabling joint evaluation of camera, scene depth, hand, and object reconstruction across all capture settings.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了EgoXperience, 一个以自我为中心的立体重建的完整模式, 包括数据收集、注释、建模和基准。
其注解管道的中心是EgoX-Engine(英语:Egox-Engine),它通过视频帧跟踪目标对象,并使用被扫描前的对象模型和所观测到的深度来估计和验证其3D外观.
SLAM估计相机将这些物体轨迹置于一个共享的世界坐标系统中,与场景几何和手记并列,提供几何对齐的监控.
将这一引擎应用于50小时的任务驱动录音,这些录音跨越工作空间的操纵、跨室交互和室外的loco操纵产生EgoX-Data-6M,并在二级时间分辨率上进一步丰富任务标题。
为了补充这一数据集,我们根据共同的训练方案,协调额外的公共互动数据集[3、39、30、58、23、12],调整其几何常规,同时保留其部分说明。
我们还建立了EgoX - Bench,从一个小时的被搁置的录音开始,从而能够对所有捕捉环境的相机、场景深度、手和物体重建进行联合评估。

blocks.en:
To translate this joint supervision into joint reconstruction, we introduce EgoX .
Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, EgoX jointly reconstructs the camera, scene depth, hands, and objects at metric scale in a shared world coordinate system, all in a single forward pass.
During training, we supervise each component and additionally use the predicted camera poses to transform object and hand predictions into normalized world coordinates, where we supervise their positions and orientations.
This ties camera, hand, and object estimation together, encouraging geometrically consistent reconstruction.
Evaluated on four benchmarks, EgoX achieves state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand–object pose recovery. It ranks first in depth, hand, and object metrics across all four benchmarks and achieves the best camera accuracy on HOI4D. Relative to the strongest competing methods, EgoX reduces camera nATE by 68.9% on HOI4D, hand W-MPJPE
and depth AbsRel by 65.6% and 42.9% on EgoX-Bench,
respectively, and improves object AUC-S 50 by 28.0% on HOT3D.
blocks.zh:
为了将联合监督转化为联合重建,我们引入了EgoX.
由于独相机以自负为中心视频和第一帧物体口罩,EgoX在一个共享的世界坐标系统中以公制尺度共同重建相机,场景深度,手和物体,全部都是以一通前行.
在训练期间,我们监督每个部件,并另外使用预测相机,将物体和手的预测转换成正常化的世界坐标,在那里我们监督它们的位置和方向。
这种相机,手,和物体的相接估计,鼓励几何结构的连贯重建.
根据四项基准评估,EgoX在现场估算和世界空间手对物体形成恢复方面实现了最先进的性能。 它在所有四个基准中在深度,手量和对象度量上排名第一,并实现了HOI4D上最好的相机精度. 相对于最强相竞方法,EgoX在HOI4D,手W-MPJPE上将相机nATE减少68.9%.

blocks.en: 3 The EgoXperience Paradigm

blocks.en:
Our EgoXperience unifies data capture, annotation and model learning for joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene depth, hands, and objects from egocentric videos.
As illustrated in Fig. EgoXperience , this paradigm comprises EgoX -Engine for data processing and annotation (Sec. 3.1 ), EgoX -Data-6M with 50 hours of task-driven recordings spanning manipulation and locomotion (Sec. 3.2 ), and EgoX for joint reconstruction from monocular video (Sec. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 EgoX -Engine
blocks.zh: 3.1 EgoX - 发动机

blocks.en:
Learning to jointly reconstruct egocentric activity requires annotations that describe the camera, scene, hands, and objects in relation to one another.
Obtaining these annotations is challenging because the observer and the interacting entities move simultaneously:
a change in image position may arise from camera motion, entity motion, or both. EgoX -Engine addresses this ambiguity by using stereo depth to recover geometry at metric scale and SLAM-estimated camera poses to align different annotations throughout each recording.
This allows hand-object motion to be expressed relative to the surrounding scene as the observer moves.
Fig. 3 summarizes the overall pipeline.
blocks.zh:
学习共同重建自我中心活动需要说明,描述相机、场景、手和物体彼此的关系。
获取这些说明具有挑战性,因为观察员和互动实体同时移动:
图像位置的变化可能源于相机运动,实体运动,或者两者兼而有之. EgoX - Engine通过使用立体深度在公尺尺度上恢复几何来解决这一模糊性,而SLAM估计相机则在每次录制过程中对齐不同的说明.
这使得手-物体运动可以随着观察者的移动而相对周围场景进行表达.

blocks.en:
Object annotation requires both a geometric reference for each instance and its changing pose during interaction.
We construct metric object meshes from 31 synchronized cameras mounted on a calibrated dome.
SAM 3 [ 11 ] then extracts object masks from the captured views, which are used for mesh reconstruction with MV-SAM3D [ 33 ] .
To recover the object’s physical dimensions, we put an AprilTag [ 42 ] board inside the dome to provide the scale reference.
blocks.zh:
对象注释需要每个实例的几何参考及其在相互作用过程中变化的姿势.
我们用31台同步相机 搭建在被校准的穹顶上 来构建标定物体
SAM 3 [11] 然后从被捕获的视图中取出物体口罩,用于与MV-SAM3D [33]进行网格重建.
为了恢复物体的物理维度,我们在穹顶内放入了AprilTag [42] 板来提供比例参照.

blocks.en:
Given these metric object references, the engine recovers each object’s motion in the egocentric recording.
Specifically,
we first identify the target object using a first-frame mask and then specify the interaction interval over which to track it.
Using the masked RGB image and its corresponding stereo depth, we estimate the initial pose of the pre-scanned object model in the camera frame.
From this initial pose, we apply FoundationPose [ 62 ] to track the object throughout the specified interval, producing a camera-relative pose sequence.
We verify this sequence by checking whether the object model placed at the estimated pose agrees with the observed depth.
Sequences that pass verification are transformed through the SLAM-estimated camera poses into the session frame, aligning object motion with the scene and hand annotations.
blocks.zh:
基于这些衡量对象的参考,引擎在以自我为中心的记录中恢复了每个对象的运动.
具体来说,
我们先用第一帧口罩识别目标对象,然后指定跟踪对象的交互间隔.
利用被蒙蔽的RGB图像及其相应的立体深度,我们估计了相机相框中被扫描前的对象模型的初始姿势.
从这个初始姿势起,我们应用FoundationPose [62] 在整个指定间隔跟踪物体,生成相机相相接姿势序列.
我们通过检查放置在估计姿势上的物体模型是否符合所观察到的深度来验证这个序列.
通过验证的序列通过 SLAM 估计相机的外观被转换入会话框架,使对象运动与场景和手语说明一致.

blocks.en:
The scene and hand annotations used in this alignment are derived from the same calibrated stereo observations.
Specifically, we reconstruct scene geometry by back-projecting stereo depth and recover 3D hand keypoints through cross-view triangulation.
We use these keypoints to constrain MANO fitting, with additional reprojection, depth, and temporal terms to refine the estimated hand geometry and motion.
Hand shape parameters are shared across frames within each recording, while hand pose, position, and orientation are estimated independently for each frame.
Finally, we transform the fitted hands and scene points through the camera trajectory into the session frame, placing them in the same metric coordinate system as the tracked objects.
blocks.zh:
此对齐中使用的场景和手语说明出自同一种校正立体观测.
具体来说,我们通过倒向投影立体深度来重建场景几何,通过交叉取景三角来恢复3D手键.
我们用这些关键点来限制MANO的装配,加上额外的再投影,深度,以及时间术语来完善估计的手几何和运动.
手形参数在每次录制中跨帧共享,而手姿,姿势,取向则对每个帧独立进行估计.
最后,我们通过相机轨迹将配有的手和场景点转换成会话框架,把它们置于与被跟踪物体相同的度量坐标系统中.

blocks.en: 3.2 EgoX -Data-6M

blocks.en:
Given EgoX -Engine, we apply it to annotate task-driven egocentric captures, constructing EgoX -Data-6M, which comprises 50 hours of video, 101 rigid objects, and 270 task scripts.
The recordings cover activities ranging from manipulation within a single workspace to interactions across rooms and loco-manipulation in outdoor environments.
The engine provides geometrically aligned camera, scene, hand, and object annotations across these settings, supporting joint reconstruction under both local manipulation and extended movement.
Fig. 2 illustrates the activity coverage and accompanying annotations.

录音涵盖各种活动,从在单一工作空间内进行操纵到在室内进行互动和室外环境中进行遥控。
该引擎在这些设置中提供几何对齐相机,场景,手和物体注释,支持在局部操纵和扩展运动下联合重建.

We organize data collection around task scripts, each specifying a manipulation goal, target objects, and
a capture setting.
Specifically, workspace scripts focus on local object manipulation, whereas cross-room and outdoor scripts incorporate movement between interaction locations.

blocks.en:
We provide geometric annotations in a session-fixed metric frame, allowing camera motion, scene structure, and hand-object interactions to be related throughout each recording.
Additionally, we include second-level task captions to describe the ongoing activity.
Tab. 1 compares our dataset with existing egocentric resources.
Compared with existing datasets, our EgoX -Data-6M brings together workspace manipulation, cross-room interactions, and outdoor locomotion with camera, scene, hand, and object annotations in a shared metric frame, supporting joint reconstruction across these activity settings.

blocks.en:
To evaluate all reconstruction components on the same recordings, we reserve a quality-controlled, one-hour subset spanning the three activity settings as EgoX -Bench.
This subset is used exclusively for joint evaluation of camera, scene, hand, and object reconstruction.

blocks.en:
To broaden the training data beyond our own recordings, we incorporate additional public datasets.
Using these datasets together requires accounting for differences in both geometric conventions and available annotations.
We therefore convert their geometric labels to a common coordinate and scale convention and supervise the model using the labels available in each dataset.
This allows recordings with partial annotations to contribute to training without requiring every dataset to provide camera, scene, hand, and object labels.
We also clean erroneous annotations and align depth with hand and object geometry to reduce conflicting supervision (Appendix B ).
Sec. 3.3 explains how the model learns from this combined supervision; the data mixture is detailed in Appendix F .

综合使用这些数据集需要考虑几何常规和可用说明之间的差异。
因此,我们把它们的几何标签转换成一个共同的坐标和比例公约,并利用每个数据集的标签监督模型。

blocks.en:
To translate the aligned supervision into joint reconstruction, we propose EgoX , which is capable of predicting the camera, scene, and motions of both hands and objects within a single model.
The central challenge to achieve this goal is that the predictions must agree geometrically as both the viewpoint and interaction change.
As illustrated in Fig. 4 , we address this through a joint scene and entity representation, followed by explicit composition through the predicted camera poses.
Supervision on the resulting hand and object motions then ties their reconstruction to camera estimation.

实现这一目标的主要挑战是,随着观点和互动的变化,预测必须几何一致。
如图4所示,我们通过联合场景和实体代表来解决这一问题,然后通过预测的相机外观来明确构成。

blocks.en:
To jointly estimate cameras, scene geometry, and hand-object motion, we encode them with a shared Transformer.
Starting from image patch features extracted by DINOv3 [ 53 ] , we introduce camera, hand, and object tokens in each view, using distinct left/right embeddings to identify the hands and first-frame mask descriptors to associate target objects across views.
These tokens gather image evidence through within-view attention and exchange information across observations through cross-view attention, forming a joint representation for reconstruction.
Architectural details are provided in Appendix F .

从DINOv3 [53]所提取的图像补丁特性开始,我们在每个视图中引入相机,手和对象符号,使用不同的左/右嵌入来识别手和第一帧口罩描述符,将目标对象连接到整个视图中.
这些道具通过内视关注来收集图像证据,并通过跨视关注来交换跨观测信息,形成重建的联合代表.

From the joint representation, we reconstruct scene geometry and hand-object motion in a common reference frame 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , defined by the first-frame camera coordinate system.
To combine predictions across views, we estimate camera intrinsics K ^ t \hat{K}_{t} and extrinsics ( R ^ t , τ ^ t ) (\hat{R}_{t},\hat{\tau}_{t}) mapping 𝒲 \mathcal{W} to camera t t .
These parameters allow us to recover scene points, wrist positions, and object origins from their image coordinates and predicted depths.
Specifically, for a homogeneous image position u ~ = ( u x , u y , 1 ) ⊤ \tilde{u}=(u_{x},u_{y},1)^{\top} and normalized depth z z , its position in 𝒲 \mathcal{W} is: 𝒰 t ​ ( u ~ , z ) = R ^ t ⊤ ​ ( z ​ K ^ t − 1 ​ u ~ − τ ^ t ) . \mathcal{U}_{t}(\tilde{u},z)=\hat{R}_{t}^{\top}\left(z\hat{K}_{t}^{-1}\tilde{u}-\hat{\tau}_{t}\right). (1) This shared mapping ties scene and entity positions to the same camera estimates.
For hand and object orientations, we similarly use inverse camera rotation R ^ t ⊤ \hat{R}_{t}^{\top} to transform camera-frame hand and object orientations into 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , keeping MANO joint rotations local and expressing object rotations relative to their first-frame orientations.

To recover metric scale, we apply a shared ScaleHead to predict one positive factor s ^ \hat{s} for the sequence, scaling scene points and camera, wrist, and object positions consistently: p ^ 𝒲 = s ^ ​ 𝒰 t ​ ( u ~ , z ) \hat{p}^{\mathcal{W}}=\hat{s}\,\mathcal{U}_{t}(\tilde{u},z) .

blocks.en:
Building on this shared reconstruction, we supervise not only individual predictions but also the resulting hand-object geometry in 𝒲 \mathcal{W} .
To compute this geometric supervision, we transform hand and object predictions through the estimated cameras and compare the reconstructed geometry with ground truth.
The resulting loss backpropagates through the camera transformations, updating both entity and camera predictions.
We combine these supervision terms into the training objective: ℒ = ℒ local + ℒ dense + ℒ coupled + ℒ scale , \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{local}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dense}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coupled}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{scale}}, (2) where ℒ local \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{local}} supervises camera and view-local entity predictions, ℒ dense \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dense}} supervises depth and scene points, ℒ coupled \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coupled}} supervises the composed hand-object geometry, and ℒ scale \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{scale}} supervises metric scale.
To accommodate varying annotation coverage across datasets, we apply each loss only where its required labels are available, allowing fully and partially annotated data to contribute to the same objective.
Loss definitions and training settings are provided in Appendix F .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion

blocks.en:
We present EgoXperience, a unified approach to learning
world-grounded egocentric representations through task-driven
capture, geometrically aligned annotation, and joint reconstruction.
EgoX-Engine provides aligned multimodal annotations for
the 50-hour EgoX-Data-6M, from which we curate the held-out
one-hour EgoX-Bench.
Trained on these annotations and harmonized public datasets,
EgoX jointly reconstructs cameras, dense depth, hands,
and rigid-object 6-DoF poses in a common metric world frame.
Experiments on EgoX-Bench and public benchmarks demonstrate
strong performance in hand and object reconstruction
and depth estimation.
Our current formulation assumes rigid objects and does not
predict their meshes.
Future work will explore object mesh prediction and
multiview inputs.

either external input. Its reconstruction losses evaluate hand, object,
and depth predictions through the predicted camera, providing training
signals for camera estimation.

blocks.en: Appendix B Public Dataset Cleaning and Geometric Alignment

blocks.en:
We systematically clean HOT3D, HOI4D, H2O, H2O-3D, HO-Cap,
and DexYCB before joint training. We discard frames with erroneous
hand annotations and remove spurious points from depth-derived
point clouds. We further align depth-derived geometry, MANO hand
meshes, and object meshes in a common 3D coordinate system,
correcting inconsistencies in their relative placement and scale.
These steps reduce erroneous labels and conflicting geometric
supervision across reconstruction tasks.

blocks.en:
We combine the EgoX-Data-6M training split with six independently
sourced public interaction datasets: HOT3D [ 3 ] , HOI4D [ 39 ] , H2O [ 30 ] , HO-Cap [ 58 ] ,
H2O-3D [ 23 ] , and DexYCB [ 12 ] . We reprocess them so that depth, hand geometry,
and object geometry agree under consistent metric camera conventions,
avoiding contradictory supervision across tasks. Additional real-world
sources are Xperience-10M [ 52 ] , ACE-Data-0 [ 7 ] , and AgiBot World 2026 [ 1 ] ; synthetic sources are Aria
Synthetic Environments [ 2 ] , BEHAVIOR-1K [ 34 ] , SceneNet RGB-D [ 41 ] , and Dynamic
Replica [ 28 ] . The pool contains approximately 280 hours. Training first
mixes real and synthetic sources and then continues on an equal mixture
of the retained real interaction sources. We sample T ∈ { 1 , … , 24 } T\in\{1,\ldots,24\} observations per input set.

Patch features from DINOv3 ViT-L/16 feed a 24-block reconstruction
Transformer with a hidden dimension of 1024. Nineteen blocks exchange
all tokens across views, while the remaining five operate on compact
register and entity tokens. Camera and depth heads read fused image
features, whereas hand and object heads read their view-specific entity
states. The model uses learned spatial and reference embeddings without
temporal encoding.
